subject: SOC 2 follow-up: remediation status for finding & bridge letter request (FinTrust)
messages:
From: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@fintrust.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Bryce <michael.bryce@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 follow-up: finding 4.2 — management response & bridge letter

Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. During our internal review of your SOC 2 Type II materials we noted Finding 4.2 (incomplete access logging for internal admin console) and the auditor's note referencing an exception during the period Nov 1, 2024 — Apr 30, 2025. Can you confirm:

- Whether the remediation has been completed, and on what date it was considered effective by your auditor?
- Whether Redwood will provide a bridge letter that clearly states the remediation date and that the exception is closed for the affected audit period?
- Any supporting artifacts we can share with our compliance reviewers (management response, remediation tracker, proof of fix).

We need to present these to our InfoSec team by EOD Wednesday (Nov 5). If you can point us to the evidence or provide a draft bridge letter, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sarah Nolan\Security Program Manager\FinTrust

Attachment: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@fintrust.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:45 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: finding 4.2 — management response & bridge letter

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask. High-level update: we completed the remediation for the access-logging gap and deployed the fix on 2025-10-17; BrightAudit performed verification against the fix on 2025-10-28 and noted the remediation as effective as of 2025-10-22 (their verification notes are in progress).

I'm attaching our current remediation tracker that shows the timeline and artifacts (see attached spreadsheet). We are preparing a short management response letter and an auditor-validated bridge letter — those are in final review with legal and our auditor. I expect we can provide drafts by Tuesday evening (Nov 4) and the finalized bridge letter on Nov 5.

If your team needs an immediate call to walk through the evidence, I'm available tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer\Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales\Redwood Inference\karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123\\nAttachment: remediation_tracker_fintrust.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@fintrust.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:07:30 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: finding 4.2 — management response & bridge letter

Sarah, Karthik —

Following up with the technical and control detail to support the management response. Short summary below and the artifacts noted at the end. Happy to jump on a call if you want the security team to talk through the technical evidence.

Root cause: an access control configuration in our internal admin console allowed elevated no-logging sessions for a short set of deploy-time maintenance APIs (this was a narrow scope change introduced as part of a rollout).

Remediation steps taken (timeline):
- 2025-09-30: Identified misconfigured maintenance-only endpoint; created remediation ticket
- 2025-10-03: Applied configuration change to enable persistent audit logging on the maintenance endpoints
- 2025-10-10: Deployed enhanced centralized audit pipeline (aggregator + immutable store) to capture all admin-console events
- 2025-10-17: Full deployment to prod completed (no further missing events observed)
- 2025-10-22: Internal verification complete; control owner signed off
- 2025-10-28: BrightAudit performed on-site verification of the control and confirmed effective remediation date of 2025-10-22 (auditor notes to follow)

Evidence we will provide:
- management_response_fintrust.docx (management response describing cause, remediation, and owner sign-off)
- remediation_tracker_fintrust.xlsx (timeline, Jira ticket ids, commits)
- redwood_soc2_t2_report_2024.pdf (official SOC 2 Type II report PDF; note the report includes finding 4.2 with auditor commentary)
- logs/evidence: link to immutable audit bucket and a short export (referenced in the tracker)

Auditor status: BrightAudit has indicated they will include a verification statement in our auditor supplement and can sign the bridge letter. We are coordinating the exact language; legal is aligning it with your requirements.

Planned delivery: We will provide the draft management response and a draft bridge letter by COB Nov 4; final signed bridge letter from BrightAudit by Nov 5.

Regards,
Mina Haddad\Head of Compliance Operations (acting)\Redwood Inference\mina@redwood.com

Attachment: management_response_fintrust.docx (document stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nolan <sarah.nolan@fintrust.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, BrightAudit - auditor <audit@brightaudit.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: remediation status for finding & bridge letter request (FinTrust)

Sarah —

Thanks again for the patience. Quick confirmations:

- Remediation was implemented and internally verified as of 2025-10-22.
- BrightAudit completed their verification on 2025-10-28 and will include a verification statement in the auditor supplement.
- We are issuing the formal bridge letter (BrightAudit-signed) today, and I have attached the final PDF for your records. The bridge letter explicitly states the remediation date (2025-10-22) and confirms that the exception referenced in the SOC 2 report is closed for the audit period Nov 1, 2024 — Apr 30, 2025.

Attachments included: redwood_soc2_t2_report_2024.pdf, management_response_fintrust.docx, remediation_tracker_fintrust.xlsx, bridge_letter_fintrust_2025-11-05.pdf

If your InfoSec reviewers need an annotated walkthrough of any artifact, we can set a 30-minute session this week.

Best,
Karthik Iyer\Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales\Redwood Inference\karthik@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
